in_marathi.name: Nivriti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desire, Longing, Craving
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nivriti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nivriti is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'nivritti' which means 'desire' or 'longing'. It is a name that symbolizes a deep yearning for something, be it spiritual enlightenment, love, or inner peace. In Hindu mythology, Nivriti is also the name of a goddess who is worshipped for her ability to fulfill desires and grant wishes.
